title: Lingmo OS 5.0 26b08 (Lithium)
content:
# Lingmo OS 5.0 26b08 (Lithium)

**Release Date:** November 28, 2026

### New Features

- Added a Recheck action below Update Now on the Updates page in Settings when updates are detected.
- Added a Stage Manager toggle in Settings. The preference is saved as `StageManager/Enabled` and applied immediately by the compositor preference listener.
- Added a Control Style selection in Settings.
- Introduced the Efficiency Mode interface.

### Updates

- Updated the kernel to 7.3.4.
- Updated the Photos app.
- Updated the Clock app.
- Updated Aurora to version `1.2.3` and synchronized the Debian package version.
- Changed the About page to read the installed `aurora-version` metadata.
- Stage Manager is disabled by default when no user preference has been saved. Explicitly saved preferences remain unchanged.
- Updated Debian to 13.8.

### Optimizations

- Improved Stage Manager cards with full-card thumbnails, overlaid application icons, alternating tilt effects, and ordering by most recently used.

### Bug Fixes

- System notifications displayed as non-interactive overlays no longer close the launcher.
- Clicking an empty area of the launcher after renaming a folder now commits the rename without closing the launcher.
- The file manager Properties window now resizes according to its content and centers the page content.
- Fixed a desktop crash caused by opening the Properties window.
- Fixed an issue that prevented the video player from playing videos correctly.

### Scope

This release note covers the published software package changes in the 26b08 batch.

title: Lingmo OS 5.0 26b05 (Lithium)
content: ## Lingmo OS 5.0（26b05）  - **功能更新：** 新增定时检查更新、高级更新设置及通知中心更新进度显示，支持本地化更新说明和富文本展示；新增通知中心共享小组件、组件外观设置及屏幕键盘快捷键配置。 - **优化：** 调整设置页面布局和预览效果，完善主题同步及图标缓存刷新，改进更新版本识别和更新渠道匹配。 - **修复：** 修复桌面启动器误打开文本编辑器、隐藏桌面图标后右键菜单不可用、固定应用后 Dock 放大不稳定、启动时主题未正确应用及状态图标未及时刷新等问题；修正构建时间格式。

title: Lingmo OS 5.0 26a17 (Lithium)
content:
## What's New
- New Software Update page in Settings with real-time download and install progress
- Improved system service architecture with UpdateManager
- Performance improvements across the desktop

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed sidebar category grouping in Settings
- Fixed display manager startup sequence
- Fixed font config update on language change

## Known Issues
- This is an Alpha release; some features may be unstable
